> **Fixture Notice (`dev-fixtures/`):** Demonstrates how an `unsuccessful-approach` note with `evidence_status: obstructed-attempt` states the exact hypothesis that failed without claiming a general no-go theorem.

## Obstruction Summary

Attempting to parameterize the bond expectations $U_{ij}^{\mu\nu} = \langle i c_i^\mu c_j^\nu \rangle$ around an isolated $W_p = -1$ vortex using a uniform asymptotic value without radial and angular bond-type relaxation violates local self-consistency of the electric quadrupole profile ([Freitas et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.15750)). This records the breakdown of a restricted ansatz, not a theorem that analytical asymptotic approximations cannot be constructed.
